test_title: PYST 132: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 27 Jan, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

Statements:

All leaves are plants.

All plants are trees.

All trees are big.

Conclusions:

I. Some trees are leaves.

II. All leaves are big.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7875563429660f285e09d59a42d943a3b102632df9dc3e06cd335c208ef8ee42.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some trees are leaves. → **Follows **(As, All leaves are plants and All plants are trees, so some part of trees are also leaves)

II. All leaves are big. → **Follows** (As, All leaves are plants, All plants are trees and All trees are big, so all leaves are big)

Hence, '**Both conclusions I and II follow**' is the correct answer.
